name: agentrag
description: AgentRAG: x402-paid retrieval-augmented generation for agents. Ingest your own documents or URLs into a collection (hybrid BM25 + vector search), then ask grounded questions against them — paid per call in USDC, no accounts or API keys.

private_key.title: Wallet private key (optional)
private_key.description: EVM private key (hex, 0x-prefixed) for the wallet that pays. Leave blank and AgentRAG mints + manages a local wallet for you on first use (then fund it).

account_key.title: Account key (optional)
account_key.description: An ak_ bearer token for managed-wallet (credit) mode. Funded out-of-band via AgentKV. If a wallet private key is also set, the account key silently wins and the wallet key is ignored.

endpoint.title: AgentRAG endpoint
endpoint.description: The AgentRAG API endpoint. Defaults to the hosted service.

network.title: Network (optional)
network.description: CAIP-2 network id: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet, default) or eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia testnet).

max_spend_usd.title: Max per-operation spend, USD (optional)
max_spend_usd.description: Refuse any single operation that would cost more than this. Leave empty for no per-op cap.

max_session_spend_usd.title: Max session spend, USD (optional)
max_session_spend_usd.description: Refuse operations once cumulative spend across the whole MCP session exceeds this. Leave empty for no session cap.
